'''Hershel Sheridan's house''' was a residential building in the city of [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:CCFTLM" />

==History==
The house stood near [[Kor Vella Starport|the city's starport]] at the foot of the Kor Vella mesa. It was a one-storied building with only three small rooms connected by a hallway.<ref name="SWG:CCFTLM" /> The politician [[Hershel Sheridan]] lived here until he was murdered by the [[Chirq Council]].<ref name="SWG:CCFTUM" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an adventurer working for [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] officer [[Lon Cope]] as an independent agent entered the house and found the corpse of Hershel Sheridan who had been shot by the Chirq Council.<ref name="SWG:CCFTLM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hershel Sheridan's house appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CCFTLM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Hershel Sheridan's house was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref> It can be found near the starport in Kor Vella on Corellia. The player has to enter this house twice to examine Sheridan's corpse during the quests "[[:w:c:swg:CorSec Case Files: The Lucky Mayor|CorSec Case Files: The Lucky Mayor]]" and "[[:w:c:swg:CorSec Case Files: The Unlucky Mayor|CorSec Case Files: The Unlucky Mayor]]," which are part of the [[:w:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy quest]], the longest quest line in the game.<ref name="SWG:CCFTLM" /><ref name="SWG:CCFTUM" />
